en: Having been here for a while now, I've found that everything, from the environment and the work to the salary, is beyond satisfactory.
Despite being in the countryside, the overall atmosphere is tranquil and elegant, it's the perfect place to relax.
However, something unexpected happens...
I somehow ended up getting involved with Ayano...
“Hey.”
“Ah—yes!”
“What are you doing standing in the middle of the hallway?”
“Thinking... about life?”
“Not feeling well?”
“Why would you think that?”
“You seem tired, and you have dark circles under your eyes.”
“Um... I had a bit of insomnia last night.”
“Do you want me to make you a cup of hot milk?”
Shizuku suddenly narrows her eyes at me, and I can feel a distinctly unhappy vibe.
“Alright, make me a cup.”
“And it's your fault I couldn't sleep.”
“Hurry up and go.”
“Right away!”
“Shizuku, your hot milk is ready, and I've also prepared some cookies.”
“I thought having something sweet might perk you up.”
“Eating sweets actually makes me sleepy.”
“But I like them, so it's fine.”
“Oh... okay, okay.”
I can't help but feel that Shizuku is a bit hard to read.
“And I don't like spicy food, make sure to remember that.”
“Got it, I'll keep that in mind.”
“So, what are you still doing here?”
“Oh, right... I'll go clean up.”
“Wait, you might as well sit down.”
“What kind of face do you make when you're feeling good?”
“…Sorry, could you say that again?”
“I said, what does your face look like when you cum?”
“Wait, wait, come? What do you mean—?”
“What else could it mean? It means when you orgasm, ejaculate.”
“Just... n-normal, I guess?”
“Is that so?”
What in the world is this bizarre conversation about?
I'm still wondering if I heard it wrong.
“Still, I can't quite picture it.”
“That... why are you asking me this?”
“Don't mind me. None of your business.”
“Haaa...”
“Thanks, the milk was good and the cookies were tasty.”
“I'm going back to my room to catch up on some sleep.”
“...Rest well.”
